boxes.meaning: careful use of time or resources

english.meaning: careful use of time or resources
english.note: Use this when the means being managed are resources rather than time.

examples.english: Only with good resource management can we make good use of limited resources.
examples.traditional: 要做好資源管理，先可以善用有限資源。
